title: Validate gateway CBOR slot-map dimensions before owned_slots
description: rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs decoders truncate arbitrary CBOR integers with as u8/u16 and SlotMap::from_cbor_map accepts gateway_count=0 or ordinal>=count. SlotMap::owned_slots then increments by gateway_count; zero causes an infinite loop, and wrapped/out-of-range values can produce invalid allocations. Reject negative/overflow integers, require nonzero bounded gateway_count, ordinal<gateway_count, and validate contiguous ranges/capabilities before returning decoded objects. Add hostile CBOR tests including gateway_count zero.
